Commentary.Commentary: The inevitable has happened, the game has been called off! South Africa has now qualified directly for the 50-over World Cup Ireland needed to win all three games. Two more games to go though in this series with the second game to begin at 1515 IST (0945 GMT) on the 12th of this month! Till then, goodbye and take care!
It is pouring out there now and the ground is full of puddles. Not long now before this game is called off.
The wait continues, the rain continues to fall, the chances of the game resuming looks unlikely. The covers are firmly placed for now.
Nothing new to update! The rain continues to fall and things just do not look great at the moment.

Well, the rain is now coming down and the umpires have decided to go off! We need 20 overs to be completed to get a result and we still have not done so. Let us hope the rain passes by quickly and we are at it again.
